name: ALOE (ALign With CustOmized PrEferences)
description: ALOE is a benchmark designed to measure large language models' ability to dynamically align their responses with individual user preferences through multi-turn conversations, using a dataset of 3K+ multi-turn conversations guided by diverse user personas.
reputation: A newer benchmark for personalized alignment that has seen some research interest, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Focuses on personalized alignment via interaction using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
